notes: Fixes the Twin Button OTA regression introduced by the strict prepare-confirmation gate. Smoke now uses confirmed Twin firmware capability: Twin 1.1.29 and newer must report DFU_PREPARE_READY after the real LED lead-in, while legacy Twin applications retain the compatible buttonless-DFU entry and advance only after the actual ATT write/disconnect event. Smoke uses a bounded event-driven DFU state machine, controlled terminal error indication, smooth transition from the current RGB frame into the white update cue, persistent DFU diagnostics, and automatic BLE advertising/reconnect after Smoke OTA. The embedded Twin Button 1.1.30 adds persistent DFU/application/BLE diagnostics, immediate application advertising, session/version confirmation, bounded update indication, and guarded buttonless DFU. Includes the tiras6 verified-handoff bootloader with bank copy, CRC validation, settings commit, MCU reset, application handoff journal, and USB DFULOG.TXT; installing the bootloader remains a one-time USB UF2 operation.
